plan.requires: Owner approval on 2026-11-06; synthetic tests passing; leakage audit passing; SHA-256 recorded in the run script before any EEG is read
plan.question: On held-out list blocks, does EEG averaged across readers beat matched noise, shuffled pairs, timing and list position at telling sentences apart within a block?

protected.policy: v1 test sentences, v2 test blocks and their buffers are never parsed as EEG, fitted or scored; their files are only hashed to prove they did not change; a run-time audit refuses to continue otherwise

folds.unit: One contiguous block of the list, in sentence ID order, separately for each release
folds.placement: Tile 25 list positions at a time from the start of each run outside the v2 test zone; no block crosses the zone
folds.scored_sentences: Tiled-block sentences that are not protected and not repeated, shared between releases, near-duplicated or nearly contained in another sentence
folds.buffer_policy: For each fold, training leaves out the block and 10 list positions on each side, in that release
folds.training_policy: All other usable observations from both releases

primary.window: Whole sentence, center crop only above 30 seconds

secondary_time_binned.window: Whole sentence, center crop only above 30 seconds
secondary_time_binned.features: Mean amplitude per channel in 20 equal fractions of the sentence

plan.reader_scaling: Features are computed once with no reader normalization, then z-scored per reader and fold using that reader's training rows only

averaging.primary: Mean of all available readers' scaled features for that sentence
averaging.subset_draws: Mean score over 20 seeded reader subsets per sentence for counts below all

model.type: Ridge from scaled features to the fixed text embeddings
model.alpha_selection: Inside each fold's training data only: one seeded contiguous 25-position block per release plus 10 positions each side are held back, scored on averaged features with the primary metric, then the model is refit on all of that fold's training rows

arms.gaussian: Matched noise per observation, keeping channel amplitudes, averaged the same way
arms.class_shuffled: Training targets permuted by sentence within release, mean of 10 shuffles
arms.timing: Ridge on averaged duration, word count and a training-derived word-count basis; no EEG amplitudes

position.input: Release flag and Fourier basis of list position; no EEG

arms.partial: Inside each held-out block, remove from real and noise predictions what list position, its square, word count and mean duration explain linearly. Uses no text meaning and refits nothing

evaluation.primary: Expected 10-way top-1 within each query's own held-out block, equal weight per sentence, ties are misses; chance 10%
secondary: Score against reader count for real and noise
Expected 2-way, 4-way, 10-way and 24-way against all scored sentences in the release
Model fitted on sentence means instead of single-reader rows
New readers: seeded half of each release's readers for fitting, the other half averaged for scoring, on the same held-out blocks; reported for real, noise and shuffled

decision_rule.bootstrap: 10000 resamples of sentences and of blocks; 2000 of readers within release, recomputing the average, for gaussian and class_shuffled. Two-sided 95% intervals

outcomes.condition: Beats nulls, and timing, position and partial all clear
outcomes.label: Averaged EEG carries sentence information beyond the controls

outcomes.condition: Beats nulls, and timing, position or partial does not clear
outcomes.label: The gain does not exceed timing or position
No sentence signal found with these features

decision_rule.secondary_scope: Secondary results never change the label
decision_rule.clear: Gap at least the minimum and every available lower bound above 0

refuse_if: A protected sentence reaches a read, fit or score
A held-out sentence key, sentence group or signal file appears in that fold's training
A training sentence is within 10 list positions of the fold's block in the same release
Token Jaccard at least 0.7, token containment at least 0.8 or text cosine at least 0.9 across a fold boundary
Scaling statistics use a held-out row
tests_before_run: A planted sentence signal is recovered, and improves with reader count
Noise with no signal stays at chance at every reader count
A position-only signal does not produce the first outcome
A duration-only signal does not produce the first outcome
audit.false_pass_check: On synthetic fixtures before freezing: duration-only 0 of 20 seeds and position-only 0 of 20 seeds earned the first reading; a planted signal earned it on 10 of 10

plan.test_policy: No final test data is scored. Any later confirmation on the v2 test blocks needs a new plan and the owner's decision
plan.stop_rule: Stop after this run whatever the outcome. No extra settings or models under this plan.
plan.existing_output_policy: Refuse to run if the output directory exists; hash protected prior artifacts before and after
